description: Generate pyo3 bindings from rustdoc JSON for all 36 backend crates wired into outram-park, so the maturin wheel exposes the whole simulation API (not just version()). Map uom quantities to f64 SI base units; opaque pyclass wrappers for structs/enums with field accessors and inherent methods; emit .pyi stubs for discoverability; move to abi3 so one wheel spans CPython versions. gh:#2 https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/outram-park/issues/2
title: Expose the full outram-park-backend API to Python in the outram-park wheel
